title: tulipa humilis var. pulchella
intro:
Tulipa humilis var. pulchella, commonly known as the wild tulip, is a type of flowering bulbous perennial plant that belongs to the lily family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Tulipa humilis var. pulchella include its use as a treatment for respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its ability to act as a diuretic and to stimulate the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.

Note: While the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Tulipa humilis var. pulchella are mentioned, more research is needed to confirm the accuracy of these claims.
